growth_expectations.rationale: Activity increased slight to moderate in seven Districts, five flat/declining.

inflation_concern.rationale: Prices increased moderately; nine Districts mentioned tariffs contributing to costs.

labor_market.rationale: Employment generally stable; seven Districts reported no change in hiring.

credit_conditions.rationale: Financial services stable to up; commercial lending primary area of strength.

policy_uncertainty.rationale: Many cited economic uncertainty, tariff uncertainty, and federal policy concerns.
